# Two cost bases of 1.00 USD each, priced where the pair and the parts round
# to different cents.
#
# 1.00 USD at 1.3833 is 1.3833, which is 1.38 at the cent; two of them are
# 2.76. The whole holding is 2.00 USD at 1.3833 = 2.7666, which is 2.77 — the
# figure `total_assets` carries, because GnuCash converts a holding's whole
# quantity through the price once.
#
# So a gain added up one cost basis at a time can differ by a cent from one
# measured on the holding, and `total_equity` is built on the first while
# `total_assets` is the second. This book is the smallest one that reaches it:
# two separate purchases, nothing sold, one price.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening CAD
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-12-31 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "13833/10000"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-15 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 100.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening CAD -100.00 CAD

2026-02-01 * "Buy 1.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1.30"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1.30 CAD

2026-03-01 * "Buy another 1.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1.30"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1.30 CAD
